description:
Low-risk polish from the review:

1. `cli.ex:108` — move `alias OctoPi.Coder.Tools` from inside
   `default_tools/0` to the module's alias block at top.

2. `session_store.ex:close/1` — the GenServer replies :ok then
   stops, so subsequent calls to the same pid crash. Add a
   moduledoc line noting that close is terminal.

3. `bash.ex:finalize/4` — the `is_error?` heuristic
   `reason != :exit or (is_integer(code) and code != 0)` is
   harder to read than a `case reason` + explicit status check.
   Small refactor.

4. `session_store.ex:encode_cwd/1` — document the `/a/b` vs
   `/a-b` collision (upstream has the same quirk; we preserve
   for compatibility).

5. Consider: is there anywhere else the Phase 3 code has stale
   "deferred in .N" comments now that the epic is closed? Scan
   and refresh.

No tests required — these are doc / refactor changes covered by
the existing suite.
title: Style + docs cleanup grab-bag
